why: ExpireCommit reopens the task only when otherActive (read before the transaction) and stillActive (counted inside) are both 0 and the task is still CLAIMED

PeerReviewRead needs PENDING, a non-author reviewer and no earlier review by this reviewer (findFirst, no unique index); the verdict is Math.round(avg) >= 3; contribution and task updates have no status guard
ModerateRead needs PENDING and, on accept with requireDualKey on a large leaf, one review by a non-author; contribution and task updates have no status guard; accept pays +5 once per call
Reopen sets the contribution REJECTED and the task OPEN in one transaction with no status guard and no syncProjectCompletionStatus
the project flips to COMPLETED when every claimable leaf is ACCEPTED and back when one is not

the one-active-claim promise lives in code, not in an index; ContributionReview has no unique (contributionId, reviewerId) index, which is why two concurrent reviews by one reviewer both insert. If an index is added, PeerReviewCreate must fail for the second session and the finding is fixed
